patch_description: Restores the strongest validated low-parameter architecture: globally shared RY/RZ preparation, complete-graph CZ entanglement aligned with all 28 pairwise feature channels, one adaptive central CRZ bridge, and shared RY readout mixing. It removes the tied global RX layer from the current candidate, which increased depth and gate count while reducing validation accuracy. The design retains only four parameters per block (26 total), preserves strong regularization and parameter efficiency, and previously achieved the best observed combined score, validation accuracy, and generalization behavior.
